[P3] Revisit the untested probe rejection guards

Rule 4, “Every branch has a test that fails without it,” remains unmet here and in case 23's identical `probe` guard. Every scenario supplies an active SDK span, including the `no-ambient` cases; case 23's negative tests change the helper outcome, not the tracing context. Removing either rejection leaves the existing assertions unchanged. Return to the design phase under rule 8 to establish whether these guards add a necessary contract beyond the existing parentage assertions and choose the minimum demonstrably tested approach.
